ci.source_scope: Preregistered first-use DEV only; not full Yggdrasil regression, no pilot or primary.

original_ubuntu_dev_report.limits: Two previously reused binary stochastic generator families only. 64-event stable reference is a task-defined structural advantage, NOT unknown-world zero-shot transfer. Additional frozen memory and online changepoint states add compute. Scientific primary/first-use, real-world grounding, native architecture adoption, deployment, full regression and autonomous training are not justified by a DEV result.

interpretation.partial_positive: Contrastive action-evidence recall beat original native, fixed .93 causal template and bounded Beta BOCPD pooled late-phase Brier on both DEV seeds. Early return A improved against native on both.
interpretation.threshold_failure: Seed 44111 candidate 0.146115 exceeds absolute 0.145 cap. On both seeds gain over strongest control is below preregistered 0.010, and late-return-A superiority versus original native falls far short of 0.020.
interpretation.control_strength: An explicit fully fitted Bayesian online changepoint Beta model with 1/72 constant hazard and 48-run truncation was weaker than native discounted causal basis on this existing binary family. This does not mean changepoint methods are generally inferior.
interpretation.source_warm_advantage: Frozen A is trained on the first task-guaranteed stable 64 observations. This is a structural warm-segment assumption that limits generality and is never hidden as unknown-world transfer.
interpretation.no_new_action_identity_claim: The fixture tests source-consistent binary action-symbol relabeling only for the BOCPD control; it does not create any previously unseen action semantics.

boundaries: Engineering development test PASS is not a scientific pass. CKAD43 and CKAD42 remain DEV_NO_GO.

Original source and action budgets are matched, but adding an extra frozen specialist and 48-run Bayesian filtering increases compute, so whole-process CPU and wall receipts are not an efficiency comparison.

These worlds reuse CKAD39 synthetic A->B->A causal structures and bit-action identities; no genuinely unfamiliar causal family, real-world grounding, or independent action-identity transfer was established.
Original CKAD44 primary and pilots never run. Consumed DEV cohort 44111/44112 is not to be reused for new science or hyperparameter tuning.
